Consolidated the transport search telemetry plumbing around a single context object.

What changed:
- Added [SearchTelemetryContext.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/SearchTelemetryContext.java) to bundle immutable request attributes plus the request start timestamp.
- Updated [TransportSearchAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/TransportSearchAction.java) to:
  - build telemetry context once per request,
  - pass that context through `SearchPhaseProvider`,
  - pass it into `SearchTelemetryListener`,
  - and reuse a helper for context creation instead of rebuilding the map/timestamp pairs inline.
- Updated [AbstractSearchAsyncAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/AbstractSearchAsyncAction.java) to store the telemetry context instead of a raw map.
- Updated [SearchQueryThenFetchAsyncAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/SearchQueryThenFetchAsyncAction.java) and [SearchDfsQueryThenFetchAsyncAction.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G002_elasticsearch/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/SearchDfsQueryThenFetchAsyncAction.java) to accept the telemetry context instead of a bare attribute map.

Net effect:
- The same telemetry data is still recorded.
- The transport layer no longer threads `Map<String, Object>` and `absoluteStartMillis` separately through multiple listeners and async phases.
